remote_epoch_fencing.why: Distinct epoch-bearing idempotency keys prevent duplicate same-command effects, not application of an older command after a newer one. Eventual reconciliation does not prevent the forbidden regression.

cheapest_first_cardinality.proof: For nonnegative independent costs, the k cheapest items have no greater total cost than any other k-item subset. A cost-sorted greedy scan accepts the longest feasible cheapest prefix (including every zero-cost item); no later cheaper item exists after the first nonfitting item. Thus any larger feasible subset would contradict the minimal-prefix cost. Its secondary net and tertiary ID objectives can still fail.
